items.headline: BlackRock, Inc. discloses change in voting rights for Domino's Pizza Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. filed a notification regarding its crossing of the 5% voting rights threshold in Domino's Pizza Group PLC.

items.headline: BlackRock discloses holdings in Prologis
items.summary: BlackRock reported holding discretion over 10.19 million shares of Prologis in a recent regulatory filing.

items.headline: Microsoft Updates Clarity Analytics Tool with AI Agent Tracking Features
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced three new features to its Clarity analytics platform to help website owners monitor interactions from both human users and AI agents.

items.headline: Fermaca Named First NVIDIA Cloud Partner in Mexico
items.summary: Fermaca has been designated as the first NVIDIA Cloud Partner in Mexico and is launching an AI factory platform powered by NVIDIA B300 NVL72 systems.

items.headline: QUICK SPARK: Trump Celebrates Stock Rally Fueled by His Own Party’s Midterm Defeat
items.summary: Trump claims record highs after Democrats’ midterm sweep, but no major index set a record; the Dow surged 2.9% while oil fell 7%.

items.headline: VTI Vs. SPY: Why Wall Street's Post-Midterm Rally Isn't as Broad as It Looks
items.summary: VTI and SPY rally after Democrats win Congress, but mega-cap tech concentration raises questions about the rally's breadth.

items.headline: From Pharmaceuticals to PCs: HP Bets on Emma Walmsley to Navigate Chip Crisis
items.summary: HP stock rises as former GSK CEO Emma Walmsley is named chief amid soaring memory costs, declining PC shipments and growing AI opportunities.

items.headline: Bernstein Increases Price Target on Vertex Pharmaceuticals
items.summary: Bernstein raised its price target on Vertex Pharmaceuticals to $620 from $608.

items.headline: Apple, Tesla Supplier Is Taking on 3M: Here's What Investors Should Know
items.summary: Crown New Materials' blockbuster IPO puts China's specialty adhesive industry in focus as it competes with 3M and Nitto Denko.

items.headline: BlackRock-Managed Funds Provide Credit Facility to Titan OS
items.summary: Funds and accounts managed by BlackRock participated in a $46 million financing round for Titan OS, contributing a credit facility to the company's total $110 million funding.

items.headline: Amazon Launches Shop Direct Merchant Workspace
items.summary: Amazon has introduced the Shop Direct Merchant Workspace, a new portal designed to help merchants integrate their own stores with Amazon's platform.

items.headline: Above Security Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Above Security has joined the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program to accelerate its B2B sales by leveraging Microsoft's global customer network.

items.headline: PowerDMARC Launches on Microsoft Marketplace
items.summary: PowerDMARC has made its email authentication and domain security platform available on the Microsoft Marketplace for streamlined procurement.

items.headline: QUICK SPARK: Microsoft Stock Hits Record High as Midterm Results Boost AI Infrastructure Bets
items.summary: Microsoft stock hits a record $558.05 as a Democratic sweep in Congress fuels bets that slower data center growth helps cloud giants.

items.headline: CVS Health Raises Its Outlook, Confirms Massive Breakup
items.summary: CVS plans to split into two public companies by 2028, separating healthcare and retail units despite beating Q3 earnings and raising guidance.

items.headline: McDonald's Initiates Testing of New Value-Oriented Meal Bundles in U.S.
items.summary: McDonald's has launched an eight-week test of new value-oriented meal bundles across approximately 1,900 U.S. restaurants to address declining traffic and competitive pressure.
